strings.zh: 松松软软的床呢！{NEWLINE}好好地休息一下吧……{SCROLL}
strings.en: A comfy bed!{NEWLINE}Time to sleep...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 神清气爽！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ah, refreshed and restored!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 豪华游轮圣安努号{NEWLINE}已经抵达浅葱码头了！
strings.en: The luxury liner S.S. Anne has arrived{NEWLINE}at Olivine Harbor!

strings.zh: 豪华游轮圣安努号{NEWLINE}已经抵达枯叶码头了！
strings.en: The luxury liner S.S. Anne has arrived{NEWLINE}at Vermilion Harbor!

strings.zh: 唔呕……{NEWLINE}大海上这轻飘飘的感觉{CLEAR}完全不如踩在石头上踏实啊。
strings.en: Urp... This floaty feeling out at sea is{NEWLINE}nothing like standing on good solid{CLEAR}rock.

strings.zh: 好晕啊……{SCROLL}派对什么的无所谓啦,{CLEAR}让我先睡会儿。
strings.en: So dizzy...{SCROLL}Forget the party. Let me sleep for a{NEWLINE}bit.

strings.zh: 输给你,也让我清醒了！{SCROLL}我会洗心革面,好好工作的。{NEWLINE}请不要告诉船长{CLEAR}我在这里偷懒睡觉好吧？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Losing to you has woken me up.{NEWLINE}I will mend my ways and work hard.{SCROLL}Can you keep it a secret that I was{NEWLINE}taking a nap here?{CLEAR}Please don’t tell the Captain.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 上次去常磐森林写生,{NEWLINE}遇到了一个很有素描才华的女孩呢。{SCROLL}不过她的兴趣似乎不只画画,{NEWLINE}对口袋妖怪的热爱{CLEAR}也牵扯了她很多精力。{SCROLL}如果她能把心思都放在画画上,{NEWLINE}将来一定能成为了不起的画家。
strings.en: When I went sketching in Viridian{NEWLINE}Forest, I met a girl with a real gift for{CLEAR}drawing.{SCROLL}But drawing isn’t her only passion. Her{NEWLINE}love of Pokémon takes up a lot of her{CLEAR}time too.{SCROLL}If she put her whole heart into drawing,{NEWLINE}she could become a great artist{CLEAR}someday.
strings.notes: Probably a nod to Yellow (Adventures), who sketches.

strings.zh: 哦？想在派对开始之前{NEWLINE}就跟我来场对战吗？{CLEAR}没问题,乐意奉陪！
strings.en: Oh? Want to battle me before the party{NEWLINE}starts? Sure, happy to oblige!

strings.zh: 能跟你这么厉害的训练家对战{NEWLINE}真是不虚此行。
strings.en: Battling a Trainer as strong as you{NEWLINE}made this trip worth it.

strings.zh: 大叔我啊,可是水产养殖专家。{NEWLINE}一会儿在派对上给你看看我的宝贝！
strings.en: Me? I’m an expert fish farmer. At the{NEWLINE}party later, I’ll show you my treasure!

strings.zh: 这个光头大叔总是说{NEWLINE}自己的有很了不得的口袋妖怪。{CLEAR}可是问他是什么也不说,{CLEAR}非要到派对上才拿出来。{CLEAR}真是急死人了。
strings.en: That bald guy keeps saying he has an{NEWLINE}amazing Pokémon. But when you ask what{CLEAR}it is, he won’t say.{SCROLL}He insists on bringing it out at the{NEWLINE}party. It’s driving me crazy.

strings.zh: 乔伊『呀,居然是你！{SCROLL}乔伊『能一直跟你巧遇{NEWLINE}说明咱们两个很有缘分啊。{CLEAR}就冲这份缘分,{CLEAR}随时欢迎你来我房间的床上休息。
strings.en: Joy: Oh, it’s you!{SCROLL}Joy: We keep bumping into each other.{NEWLINE}It must be fate.{SCROLL}And for fate’s sake, you’re welcome to{NEWLINE}rest on the bed in my room anytime.

strings.zh: 吉利蛋『Cha——see！
strings.en: Chansey: Cha-see!

strings.zh: 呼,真是场精彩的对战。
strings.en: Whew, what a great battle.

strings.zh: 卡咪龟『War——tor！
strings.en: Wartortle: War-tor!

strings.zh: 小绿『你先去船长室吧{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}等我的精灵解除了混乱状态就去帮你！
strings.en: Blue: Go on to the captain’s cabin,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}. Once my Pokémon snap out of{CLEAR}their confusion, I’ll come help!

strings.zh: 乔伊『你们又跟火箭队起冲突了？{SCROLL}乔伊『唉,何必呢,遇事冷静点{NEWLINE}或许就能找到最好的解决办法了。
strings.en: Joy: You clashed with Team Rocket{NEWLINE}again?{SCROLL}Joy: Sigh... Why bother? If you keep{NEWLINE}calm when trouble comes, you might find{CLEAR}the best way out.

strings.zh: 哦！我真是个意外！
strings.en: Oh! Well, that was unexpected!

strings.zh: 豪华游轮圣安努号{NEWLINE}已经抵达水都群岛码头了！
strings.en: The luxury liner S.S. Anne has arrived{NEWLINE}at Alto Mare Harbor!

strings.zh: 因为以前发生过{NEWLINE}火箭队劫持游轮的恐怖袭击事件,{CLEAR}所以精灵联盟特地派我{CLEAR}来做这里的保安队长。{SCROLL}我是拥有10枚徽章的高级训练家哦,{NEWLINE}如果你在旅途中无聊的话,{CLEAR}可以来找我锻炼一下。{SCROLL}要与保安队长较量吗？
strings.en: Because of the terrorist attack when{NEWLINE}Team Rocket hijacked this ship...{SCROLL}...the Pokémon League sent me here as{NEWLINE}head of security.{SCROLL}I’m a Senior Trainer with 10 Badges. If{NEWLINE}you get bored on your trip, come train{CLEAR}with me.{SCROLL}Want to take on the head of security?

strings.zh: 好！接招吧！
strings.en: All right! Here I come!

strings.zh: 真是一场让人冒汗的较量！{NEWLINE}随时欢迎你再来找我切磋。
strings.en: What a sweaty match! Come spar with me{NEWLINE}again anytime.

strings.zh: 看到桌上的这束花,{NEWLINE}我就想起以前在城都地区遇到的一位{CLEAR}去桐树林找冰空花束的老伯伯。{SCROLL}也不知道最后他找到没有。
strings.en: These flowers on the table remind me of{NEWLINE}an old man I met in Johto...{SCROLL}...who went to Ilex Forest looking for{NEWLINE}Gracidea. I wonder if he ever found any.

strings.zh: 我想跟小福蛋一起,{NEWLINE}成为一名优秀的口袋妖怪护士。{CLEAR}为此我们踏上了周游各地的旅途。
strings.en: Happiny and I want to become great{NEWLINE}Pokémon nurses. So we set out on a{CLEAR}journey around the regions.

strings.zh: 小福蛋『Haaaa——pi！
strings.en: Happiny: Haaaa-pi!
